title: FOOD ENGINEERING AND PROCESSING I
description: Covers fundamental engineering principles for scientists and non-process engineers. Explores unit conversion, mass and energy balances, heat transfer, thermal processing, and lethality. Directed at food scientists and other majors who need or would like a working knowledge of food engineering principles.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 227, 251Z, 251HZ, 251 or 251H) and (PH 201, 211 or 211H) and FST 360.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 227, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251, MTH 251H, PH 201, PH 211 and PH 211H.
A minimum grade of D- is required in FST 360.
meeting_html: R 12pm-1:50pm in WGND 132 - Wiegand Hall 132 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
